verdict.rationale: DBOS workflows are written as ordinary annotated Python/TypeScript functions with automatic checkpointing of steps and durable recovery, requiring no YAML or DSL — confirmed by docs, GitHub description, and independent HN commentary on ergonomics and mechanism. Missing for 10: no first-party evidence of workflow authoring in additional languages beyond Python/TypeScript, and one community complaint notes annotation-based API friction in non-supported languages (Clojure).
